值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入了解這款超大型遊戲典藏盒的精緻開箱過程與豐富周邊內容。
  • 揭密典藏盒內「不包含遊戲本體」的獨特發行模式，避免收藏者產生誤解。
  • 提供給喜愛 GTA 與遊戲周邊的玩家最具參考價值的開箱評價與購買考量。

摘要

興奮開箱超巨大典藏盒

作者難得迎來一次令他相當盡興的開箱體驗，開箱這款在台灣由特定通路銷售的超大型高級典藏盒。整個外盒體積龐大且沉重，外觀融入了遊戲城市與標誌性的卡通角色元素，如鱷魚、河馬等。作者興奮地將其翻開，發現整個收納箱採用了多層抽屜式設計，充滿了拆禮物的探索樂趣。

豐富多元的專屬周邊配件

隨著抽屜逐層拉開，作者展示了多樣化的周邊，包括戴著墨鏡的鱷魚造型公仔、質感十足的金屬遊戲收納盒、一口烈酒杯，以及印有 GTA 風格的鏡子與貼紙。底層抽屜還附有一張細節滿滿的超巨大遊戲實體地圖、咖啡攪拌匙與精緻鑰匙圈，最上層甚至還配備了帽子與斜背包，周邊陣容相當豐富。

This is my first time unboxing such a massive gaming product. Let's open it up. Wow, it’s huge. Here we go, oops, let me flip it over. The box is right here. It has drawers in the front.

, let’s check them one by one. There are boxes inside. What is this? Oh, it’s the crocodile figure, with sunglasses. That's right, its sunglasses. It's pretty cute. Does it look good on my big face? How is it? Is it okay? Alright, a metallic game case, it looks quite a bit like a game disc case. And what is this ? I’m going to guess blindly. A shot. glass. Just some cute little items. Wow . I don’t know if this set is limited edition or not. And there’s a drawer design underneath. Let me see, it’s quite a substantial set . Holy cow, a mirror. Honestly, if you like GTA, this is really something special, I mean it. And GTA stickers. Okay, I know this, it’s a.

giant map. It’s their map, but it seems like this physical version comes with a map included, which is pretty interesting and nice. And the back looks like this. Pretty cool. Oh, there are more small items. A coffee spoon, a mixing spoon. A keychain. Right, that’s all for the bottom part. There’s another layer on top. A hat, a backpack, a bag. It’s alright, I’ll film. it properly in a moment. I’ll wear it and show it to you all. There’s actually a lot of merchandise in here, but did you notice? It has a map, a cup, a mirror, a waist bag, a shot glass, the box, sunglasses— yes, and a keychain—but pay attention. It doesn't include the actual game; the game must be purchased separately. I already bought it, and as I mentioned before, it's not the disc version. I.

bought the physical edition, but it doesn't have a game disc inside either— it just has a code, so they released a physical collector's edition without the game. It's a physical version without a disc. I heard a disc version might be released later, so you can keep that in mind. Anyway, I just wanted to share this collector's box with you; it’s quite exquisite. Do you like it? Leave a comment and let me know. I think it’s pretty unique, but would you buy it? You can if you want; if you're thinking of buying it, you might want to consider it . It’s sold by major retailers in Taiwan. . That's all.
